description: Fetch the 20 latest Trustpilot reviews for any company domain: stars, title, text, date and company reply, plus its TrustScore. Vet a vendor in one call. Use it when: You are vetting a company, software tool or online shop before recommending or paying it. Not for: Local shops and restaurants; the Google reviews node covers those better. Returns: 20 reviews with stars, title, text, dates, verified flag and company reply, plus the company's TrustScore and total reviews. No reviewer identities. Typical time: about 18 s. Price: $0.022 per search (up to 20 reviews), charged only on success. One call = up to 20 reviews.
name: trustpilot-reviews
title: Trustpilot reviews
